serving-path.title: Serving path of the ten-week delivery system
serving-path.description: A client question enters the agent orchestrator, which carries OpenTelemetry trace context and gathers evidence from a read-only retrieval scope holding a Chroma vector store and a Neo4j knowledge graph. Context assembly applies a token budget and grounding gate, sends one grounded prompt to the model API, and output guardrails check schema and policy before the checked answer returns to the client.

operations-path.title: Operations path of the ten-week delivery system
operations-path.description: A proposed change leaves the delivery repository only through AI CI/CD gates with human approval, then a gated apply provisions the synthetic client environment with Terraform and Ansible. The deployed AI service produces to and consumes from a Kafka event backbone whose failures stay retained in a retry and dead-letter path. Service signals flow to observability, an SLO alert reaches the on-call engineer who can roll back through the gates, and gate decisions and apply receipts land in an audit trail. No live cloud account is involved.
